## Checklist

Tick what applies. If something does not apply to your change, leave it unticked and say why in the notes below.

- [ ] Loading, empty, and error states are handled
- [ ] No hardcoded colors, font sizes, or corner radii
- [ ] Checked in landscape and on a small and a large screen
- [ ] Domain layer has no Flutter or Firebase imports, and UI files have no business logic
- [ ] `dart format .` and `flutter analyze` show zero issues
- [ ] `flutter test` passes
- [ ] Backend: `npm run build`, `npm run lint`, and `npm test` pass
- [ ] Rules or data model change: `firestore.rules` tested in the emulator, roadmap and ERD updated
- [ ] No secrets or credentials committed
